clips.send: Someone stewing over a bad week sends this to a friend who can't let anything go, in hope that the three-step method the wealthy use actually works.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says the truly happy people he has studied, the ones who live to a hundred and the ones who are actually wealthy inside, all share one habit: they take life lightly. They let things go.

Here is the three-step method he teaches. One, acknowledge how you feel - do not deny it. Two, welcome the negative feeling instead of resisting it. Three, allow it to pass through you and release it.

His reasoning: what you resist persists. Fighting a bad feeling only keeps it stuck. Letting it move through you is what actually clears it.

What are you still resisting right now instead of just letting it pass?
